method in the risk management procedure. Risk owners are named per service.
accepted.addresses: Shows an approved information security policy covering risk analysis; the detailed risk management procedure it references is not included.

Least privilege; multi-factor authentication for all staff; encryption in transit and at
rest; central logging; tested backups; patching by severity.
accepted.addresses: Names least privilege as a principle but does not mention need-to-know, separation of duties, or how access rights are assigned and revoked.
